description.value: Baymont By Wyndham Gold River is a branded motel in Gold River on Vancouver Island, situated in one of the more remote communities accessible to touring cyclists on the island's western interior. As part of the Wyndham chain it offers a standardised mid-range stay with loyalty programme integration. Gold River is a small resource town with limited accommodation options, making this property a notable overnight option for cyclists riding the interior routes. The hotel is owned by the Mowachaht/Muchalaht First Nation, who reopened it in 2024 with Nuu-chah-nulth language and artwork throughout.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content loaded successfully but consists almost entirely of Wyndham corporate navigation and booking-interface boilerplate, with no property-specific amenity listings visible for the Gold River location. OSM provides basic identifiers (address, phone, internet_access=wlan) but per the rules, OSM amenity tags cannot be treated as authoritative without website corroboration, and the website offers no corroboration. No evidence exists in either source for bike storage, laundry, breakfast, or other cyclist-specific amenities.
concerns: Website content retrieved is almost entirely Wyndham corporate boilerplate navigation; no property-specific amenity page content was available, so all amenities remain unverifiable.
OSM fax tag present (+1-250-283-2680) but not verifiable via website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible motel operated under a recognised chain brand; the only apparent mid-range accommodation in Gold River, making it useful to touring cyclists on Vancouver Island's interior routes.
